analyticsRevamp.cloud.sessionTooltip: Sessions created in the selected period, including automation and service activity. A session counts once, on its creation date, however long it keeps running afterwards. Excludes setup, onboarding and example sessions.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.sizesChartDescript: Sessions by first billed usage each day
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerSessionTool: Total lifetime ACUs of code sessions whose first billed usage fell in this period, divided by their count. Ask queries have no session and are excluded. Sessions with no recorded usage are not counted. Usage after the period counts, so past values can change. Unavailable for quota plans or no sessions.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.sessionsToMergedTo: Share of sessions created in this period with at least one Devin-created PR currently merged, regardless of merge date. Each session counts once. Unavailable when no sessions were created.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.spendTooltip: ACUs consumed during this period by Devin, automation, code scans, Ask, indexing and Wiki, including service activity. Attributed to the day the ACUs were consumed, not the session's creation date: a session created in June and continued in August contributes to both months. Excludes Review, CLI, Desktop, Windsurf and exempt session usage. Unavailable for quota plans.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerUserTooltip: All Cloud spend this period, including service and Ask usage, divided by unique active coding users: human members who created at least one Cloud session. Members whose only activity was Ask are not in the denominator. Not average personal usage. Unavailable for quota plans or no coding users.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.activeUsersTooltip: Current human members who created a Cloud session, used Ask or used more than 0 Cloud ACUs during the selected period, counted once across selected organizations. Excludes Local, Desktop, CLI, and service accounts.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.membershipCaveat: Cloud sessions, Ask and Cloud ACUs only · based on current membership
analyticsRevamp.cloud.mergeTooltip_merge: Unique Devin-created PRs currently merged, attributed to merge date, or PR creation date when merge date is missing. Session creation may be outside the period. PR status can update later.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerPrTooltip: Lifetime ACUs of the sessions that opened the merged PRs, each session counted once, divided by unique merged PRs under the selected date attribution. Spend from sessions without a merged PR is excluded. Usage after the period counts, so past values can change. Unavailable for quota plans or no merged PRs.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.hoursTooltip: Sum of the latest calibrated time estimates for valuable, non-ignored sessions, divided by 60. Uses session creation date from Jan 1, 2026 onward. Unestimated sessions contribute nothing; this is estimated human effort, not Devin runtime.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerHourTooltip: Lifetime ACUs attributed to estimated, non-ignored sessions in this period divided by productive hours. Includes non-productive sessions' ACUs, excludes unestimated and ignored sessions. Billing attribution uses the first billing timestamp. Unavailable for quota plans or zero productive hours.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.comparisonTooltip: Days the period has no data for yet show the previous period's value for the same day number (day 1 against day 1, not calendar date).
analyticsRevamp.cloud.boundaryBillingToo: Billing and session-creation dates can fall in different periods, so the session populations behind a ratio may not match exactly.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.usersChartTooltip: Active users is daily unique activity across Cloud sessions, Ask and Cloud ACUs. Historical values use current membership; Local, Desktop and CLI-only activity is excluded. Ask counts as activity but no longer consumes ACUs, so Ask-only users add nothing to the ACU charts.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.size: Sessions with more than 0 recorded ACUs, dated by their first billed usage rather than creation, so totals can differ from Sessions over time. Includes setup, onboarding and example sessions. Sized by lifetime ACUs: XS ≤20, S ≤50, M ≤100, L ≤200, XL >200; size can change later. On quota plans, usage inside the quota is not recorded per session, so only sessions with overage appear, dated by their first overage day and sized on overage dollars (converted at $2 per ACU, as in session insights).
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.prod: Cloud spend by billed product; includes service activity. Account-wide product totals can include usage not attributed to a child organization.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.acti: Unique human members active each day, not a cumulative count.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.acus: ACUs consumed in the period, grouped by the lifetime size of the session that consumed them: XS ≤20, S ≤50, M ≤100, L ≤200, XL >200 ACUs. ACUs count on the day they were consumed rather than the session's creation date, so a long-running session contributes to every period it ran in, and its size can grow as it keeps running. Includes setup, onboarding and example sessions.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.kind: Code sessions count on their creation date, however long they keep running; Ask queries count on the day they were asked. Both exclude setup, onboarding, example and service activity.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.breakdownHelp.acti: Unique human members active each day, split into coding users (created a Cloud session that day) and Ask-only users (used Ask without creating a session that day). A member can be in different bars on different days.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.empty: No activity in this period. Try another period or organization filter.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.empty_org: No activity in this period. Try another period.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.noPermission: You do not have permission to view account metrics.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.quota: ACU analytics are unavailable on quota plans, which use dollar-based usage.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerHourChartDe: ACUs per productive hour each day
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerHourChartNo: Each day divides that day's attributed ACUs by its productive hours; days with no productive hours show 0. The rolling average and forecast follow the daily ratio, so days do not add up to the period value.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.productivityChart_: ACUs per productive hour over time
analyticsRevamp.cloud.allAcusPerPrNote: For comparison, all Cloud ACUs consumed this period divided by merged PRs: {{value}}.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.acusPerMergedPrCha: ACUs per merged PR each day

Each day averages the lifetime ACUs of the PRs merged that day; a session that opened several merged PRs splits its ACUs evenly across them. Days with no merged PRs show 0, and days do not add up to the period value.

analyticsRevamp.cloud.askSessionsTooltip: Ask queries asked in the selected period, one per question. Counted on the day the question was asked; Ask has no long-running session. Excludes Ask usage by service accounts.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.codingUsersTooltip: Current human members who created at least one Cloud session during the selected period, counted once across selected organizations. Excludes members whose only Cloud activity was Ask.
analyticsRevamp.cloud.askOnlyUsersToolti: Current human members who used Ask during the selected period without creating any Cloud session, counted once across selected organizations. Active users are coding users plus Ask-only users.

analyticsRevamp.local.activeUsersOverTim: Distinct members billed for local ACUs on each fixed UTC-8 day, from the daily billing rollups. Daily values do not add up to Active users, which counts each member once.
analyticsRevamp.local.activeUsersTooltip: Members billed for at least one local ACU (Cascade or CLI product) on any fixed UTC-8 day in the period, from the daily billing rollups. Usage that bills zero ACUs (free or quota plans) and Windsurf autocomplete or chat without agent usage do not count. Each member counts once however many days they were active.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusOverTimeByMode: ACUs billed per fixed UTC-8 day, stacked by model, from the daily per-model billing rollups (the same source as Spend by model). The 10 models with the most spend in the period are named; everything else is folded into Other models. The day in progress is left out. Usage billed without a model tag is shown as Other, so each day sums to Total ACU spend.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusOverTimeTotalT: Total ACUs billed per fixed UTC-8 day, from the daily billing rollups. The day in progress is left out. The previous period is overlaid by day number (day 1 vs day 1). Sums to Total ACU spend.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusOverTimeToolti: ACUs billed per fixed UTC-8 day, stacked by billing product. Desktop and JetBrains both bill as Cascade, so they cannot be separated per day; CLI is the Devin CLI running on its own (inside Windsurf it bills as Cascade); Plugins & ACP clients is spend the rollups attribute to neither. A long-running conversation contributes to every day it was billed on. The day in progress is left out. Sums to Total ACU spend.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusPerSessionTool: Total ACU spend (billing rollups) divided by Sessions (distinct conversation ids with activity in the period, from the local analytics service). Numerator and denominator come from different systems, so treat it as an approximation. It is a mean: a few heavy sessions dominate it and zero-ACU sessions (free or quota plans) are in the denominator.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusPerUserTooltip: Total ACU spend divided by Active users (members billed for at least one local ACU in the period). Members with no local usage are not in the denominator, so this is spend per active user, not per seat.
analyticsRevamp.local.inactiveUsersToolt: Total users minus Active users: current members with no billed local ACUs in the period.
analyticsRevamp.local.messagesSentToolti: User messages sent to local agents (Desktop, CLI and JetBrains) during the period, from the local analytics service's per-client usage records — the same source as the client ACU split. All clients combined.

analyticsRevamp.local.sessionDistributio: Sessions created split by the client the conversation ran in, from the local analytics service's per-client run records: Desktop (Windsurf / Devin Desktop, including the Devin CLI hosted in Windsurf), CLI (the Devin CLI on its own) and Plugins & ACP clients (JetBrains, every other editor or ACP client hosting Devin, and conversations that matched no known client). A conversation that ran in more than one client is counted under each of them, so the slices can add up to more than the total. Top 4 shown; 'View all products' lists every client with its group.
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsCreatedToo: Distinct conversation ids (one Cascade conversation in Desktop or JetBrains, or one Devin CLI conversation) with at least one run during the period, from the local analytics service's hourly run records bucketed in UTC-8. Conversations are counted by activity, not by creation: one started in June and continued in August counts in both months, and resuming a CLI session continues the same conversation rather than starting a new one. Each conversation counts once per period however many days it spans.
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsOverTimeTo: Distinct conversations with at least one run on each fixed UTC-8 day. A conversation active on several days is counted on each of them, so the bars can add up to more than Sessions created. The dashed line extends the trend of the trailing 7-day average daily pace to the end of the period.
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsPerUserToo: Sessions created divided by Active users (members billed for at least one local ACU in the period). Numerator and denominator come from different systems, so treat it as an approximation.
analyticsRevamp.local.spendByModelDescri: Local ACUs consumed per model in the selected period
analyticsRevamp.local.spendByModelToolti: Local ACUs billed to each model in the selected period, from the daily per-model billing rollups (fixed UTC-8 days, same boundaries as Total ACU spend). Model names come from the account's current Cascade and CLI model catalogue; models no longer listed there (retired, hidden or internal) are grouped as 'Other' per provider. The top 4 are shown here; 'View all models' lists every model.
analyticsRevamp.local.totalAcuSpendToolt: Sum of the daily billing rollups for the Cascade (Desktop and JetBrains) and CLI products over the selected period, for the current members of the selected scope. ACUs are attributed to the fixed UTC-8 day of the billed request (no daylight-saving shifts), not to when the conversation started: a conversation started in June and continued in August contributes to both months. The Devin CLI running inside Windsurf bills as Cascade. Independent of the analytics-service client split below, which can differ slightly.
analyticsRevamp.local.acusByModelTotalsS: Total spend per model in the period
analyticsRevamp.local.acusByModelTotalsT: Local ACUs billed to each model over the selected period, from the daily per-model billing rollups (fixed UTC-8 days, the same source as Spend by model), largest first. The 10 models with the most spend are named; the rest share one bar.
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsOverTimeBy: Distinct conversations with at least one run on each fixed UTC-8 day, stacked by the client they ran in: Desktop (Windsurf / Devin Desktop), CLI (the Devin CLI on its own) and Plugins & ACP clients (JetBrains, every other editor or ACP client hosting Devin, and runs with no known client). A conversation active on several days, or in several clients, is counted under each of them.
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsByModelSub: Sessions by the model they used
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsByModelDes: Local sessions per model in the selected period
analyticsRevamp.local.sessionsByModelToo: Distinct conversations with at least one run on each model during the period, from the local analytics service's per-model run records. A conversation that used several models counts under each of them, so the rows can add up to more than Sessions created. Top 4 shown; 'View all models' lists every model.
analyticsRevamp.local.agentLinesAccepted: Lines of code proposed by local agents (Desktop, CLI and plugins) that members kept, from the local analytics service's daily Cascade line statistics in fixed UTC-8 days. Lines are attributed to the day they were accepted, not to the conversation's start.
analyticsRevamp.local.activeUsersByProdu: Daily active users per billing product

Distinct members billed for local ACUs on each fixed UTC-8 day, stacked by billing product. Desktop and JetBrains both bill as Cascade, so they cannot be separated per day; CLI is the Devin CLI running on its own; Plugins & ACP clients is spend the rollups attribute to neither. A member billed for more than one product on a day counts under each, so the stacks can add up to more than that day's active users.
analyticsRevamp.overview.activeUsersChar: Members active on each complete fixed UTC-8 day, counting cloud sessions and Ask queries plus billed desktop and CLI activity. A member active on both surfaces on the same day counts once, so no day exceeds the distinct member count above. Grey bars are the matching days of the previous period; the line is the trailing 7-day average of daily active users and its dashed continuation the projection to the end of the period. Service accounts are excluded.
analyticsRevamp.overview.activeUsersTool: Current members who created a cloud session, ran an Ask query or were billed more than 0 ACUs on Cloud, Desktop or the CLI in the period, counted once however many days or surfaces they used. Any cloud session counts here, including the setup and onboarding sessions the Cloud tab excludes. Per-user ACU attribution starts on Jan 5, 2026 account-wide and May 14, 2026 for organization filters, so earlier periods only see session and Ask activity. Service accounts are excluded. Only complete days count, so the day in progress is left out.
analyticsRevamp.overview.acuSpendTooltip: ACUs consumed across every product (Cloud, Local, Review, Ask, automations and indexing) from the daily billing rollups on fixed UTC-8 days. ACUs count on the day they were consumed, not when the session was created: a Cloud, Local or Review session created in June and continued in August contributes to both months. Always account-wide: selecting organizations narrows the other metrics but not ACU spend, and the limit is the account's. Only complete days count, so the day in progress is left out.
analyticsRevamp.overview.consumptionChar: Cumulative ACUs over the complete fixed UTC-8 days of the selected period, with the previous one overlaid day by day; the day in progress is left out until it ends. The dashed line extends the trend of the trailing 7-day average daily pace (reaching into the previous period when fewer than 7 days are complete) to the end of the period. With This cycle selected, the limit line is the cycle's account-wide ACU limit.
analyticsRevamp.overview.consumptionUnav: No billing cycle covers the selected period
analyticsRevamp.overview.forecastNote: Projected from the 7-day rolling average; with fewer than 7 days of data it also uses the previous cycle.
analyticsRevamp.overview.localUnavailabl: Local (desktop and CLI) data couldn't be loaded, so this covers cloud only.
analyticsRevamp.overview.mergedPrsToolti: Pull requests opened by Devin cloud sessions and merged in the period, attributed to their merge date (or PR creation date when the merge date is missing), so the session that opened them can be older. Setup, onboarding and example sessions are excluded. Local sessions are excluded and PR status can still change after the period. Only complete days count, so the day in progress is left out.
analyticsRevamp.overview.newSessionsTool: Cloud sessions created in the period (excluding setup, onboarding and example sessions) plus local Desktop and CLI conversations billed in it, on fixed UTC-8 days. Cloud counts by creation date, so a Cloud session created in June and continued in August counts only in June; Local counts by billed activity, so a local conversation that spans periods counts in each of them. Only complete days count, so the day in progress is left out.

analyticsRevamp.period.timezoneTooltip: Dashboard days run on a fixed UTC-8 offset (PST year-round, no daylight-saving shift), and data is updated daily at 00:00 UTC-8. A range includes its start day and ends at the start of the day after the one you pick.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.resolved: Marked resolved in the latest completed Review per PR reviewed in this period, including dismissals. Missing category records are excluded. Later Reviews can change past values; these are not resolutions during the period.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.statusBr: Latest reported findings split into marked resolved (including dismissals) and remaining. Shares exclude missing category records. Later Reviews can change past values.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.reposito: Lifetime Review usage for PRs reviewed in this period, including usage outside it. Incomplete PR usage is excluded; PR counts include it. Quota usage is converted to ACU-equivalents, not invoice totals. Quota dollars convert at $2 per ACU-equivalent.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.orgAttri: How Review is attributed to organizations

Review uses the billing organization recorded on each Review, not repository ownership or your current org. Attribution can follow the PR author's billing org, the launcher's selected org, or an enterprise default, depending on how Review was triggered and your settings. Only exact matches to the selected orgs are included; older Reviews without recorded billing ownership and hidden settings-org attribution are excluded. A PR reviewed under multiple orgs can appear in each org's metrics, so org totals may not add up to the account total.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.resoluti: Current resolved share by first Review date

Marked resolved ÷ reported findings, separately for bugs and flags with valid snapshots. Grouped by the first completed Review creation day in the period, using the latest completed snapshot per PR. Resolved includes dismissals; later Reviews can revise past points. This is not a history of when findings were resolved. Days with no findings or missing counts are gaps.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.totalPrs: Review-linked PRs opened per day in this period, compared with the previous one. The dashed line extends the trend of the trailing 7-day rolling average to the end of the period.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.outcomes: Current status of Review-linked PRs opened in this period; shares use all such PRs. Merged includes later merges, closed means unmerged, open means neither. Grouped by creation day, not merge/close day; a queued Review attempt qualifies.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.usageToo: Consumption by billing day, not Review date, for the whole account or, when organizations are selected, only usage recorded against them (Reviews without a recorded billing organization drop out). Quota overage is converted to ACU-equivalents; included quota usage is unavailable. Missing records are not zero; plan changes may leave gaps. Quota dollars convert at $2 per ACU-equivalent.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.mergedUs: Lifetime Review usage averaged over PRs merged in this period with complete records. Includes usage outside the period and recorded zeros; excludes incomplete PRs. Quota usage is ACU-equivalent, not invoice totals. Quota dollars convert at $2 per ACU-equivalent.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.findings: Latest completed snapshot per PR, grouped by its first completed Review creation day in the period. Later Reviews can change past values. Resolved includes dismissals. Missing categories and security findings are excluded; these are not daily resolution events.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.sizeTool: Lifetime Review usage per PR reviewed in this period: XS ≤2.25, S ≤4.5, M ≤9, L ≤18, XL >18 ACU-equivalent. PRs with incomplete usage are excluded. Grouped by first completed Review creation day in the period; quota dollars ÷ 2. Not code size.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.reposito: Lifetime usage for PRs reviewed in this period
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.usageDis: Distribution of your pull requests by size
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.comparis: Stats for the whole account, or only the selected organizations when filtered. Changes compare the preceding equal-length period: (current − previous) ÷ previous × 100; available records may differ. PR history starts June 16, 2026; Review history April 9, 2026. Ranges starting earlier are unavailable.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.empty: No data available for this period.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.mergeRat: Review-linked PRs opened in this period that are now merged ÷ all Review-linked PRs opened in the period × 100. Includes later merges; not Merged PRs ÷ Opened PRs. Unavailable with no opened PRs.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.mergedPr: Review-linked PRs merged in this period, including PRs opened earlier. A queued Review attempt qualifies even without completion.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.pullRequ: Review pull request outcomes and statistics over time
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.mergedUs: Average spend for each pull request merged
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.prsRevie: Distinct PRs with at least one completed Review in this period, dated by the first Review in the period. Repeat Reviews of the same PR count once.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.orgFilte: Review metrics can't be filtered by organization yet

Reviews are attributed to the billing organization recorded on each Review, and this account isn't billed per organization, so most Reviews aren't attributed to any selectable organization. The filtered Review metrics below are incomplete and low or empty values don't mean Review was unused. Clear the organization filter to see account-wide Review metrics.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.reviewsT: Completed Review runs in this period, counted by the day each run was created. Re-reviews of the same PR count again here but once in PRs reviewed.
analyticsRevamp.reviewDashboard.reviewSh: Review's share of ACUs on merged PRs it shares with a Devin session

PRs merged in this period that carry both a Review and a Cloud session with complete usage records: Review ACUs ÷ (Review + Cloud session ACUs) × 100, weighted by ACUs across those PRs and grouped by merge day. Lifetime usage counts, including usage outside the period. PRs missing either side are excluded; the coverage shows how many merged PRs qualify. Quota dollars convert at $2 per ACU-equivalent.

automations.codeStep.contractBody:
$EVENT_FILE     the trigger event (read-only JSON)
$STATE_FILE     your persistent JSON, <=64KB, kept between runs
$LAST_RUN_FILE  what happened to the items you emitted before
                (read-only): {"items": [{"key", "status", "session_id"}]}
$OUTPUT_FILE    your decision — must be written before exit:
  {"run": true}                     proceed to sessions
  {"run": false, "reason": "..."}   skip this run
  {"items": [{...}, {...}]}         one session per item
Items are capped at 10 per run (max 50); extras run next time.
An item's "id" is a unit of work, not an entity: "INC-1" runs once,
ever. Add "version" (e.g. the upstream updated_at) so a reopened item
counts as new work. An item whose session fails is released and can
run again.

settings.webhookSecretHowToUse: Use it to verify every request you receive: compute HMAC-SHA256 over {webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body} with the base64-decoded key after whsec_, and compare the result with the v1,… values in the webhook-signature header. settings.webhookUrlEditHint: Changing the URL sends a new endpoint.verification event to it. Deliveries pause until the new URL responds 2xx with the request's data.nonce.
settings.webhookPendingHint: Waiting for this URL to answer the endpoint.verification event with a 2xx that includes data.nonce. No events are sent until it does — click Verify to send the event again.
settings.webhookGuideIntro: Every event is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body and Standard Webhooks signature headers, sent to the URL you register. One handler receives everything and branches on event_type — it only needs to do three things:
settings.webhookGuideStep1Body: When you add an endpoint (or change its URL, re-enable it, or click Verify) we immediately POST an endpoint.verification event whose data.nonce you must echo back: respond 2xx with that exact nonce in the body, e.g. {"nonce": "…"}. This is the only event that needs an echo — every other event just needs a 2xx. Until it passes, the endpoint stays pending and receives no events.
settings.webhookGuideStep2Body: Each request carries webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over {webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body} with your signing secret (base64-decode the part after whsec_) and compare it with the space-separated v1,… values in the signature header — any match is valid, and there are several while a secret rotation is in progress.
settings.webhookGuideStep3Body: Return a 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else is retried with backoff for about three days, after which the endpoint is disabled. Retries and replays reuse the same webhook-id, so treat a repeated ID as already handled.

migrations.examples.javaSpringBoot: our order service from Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7 to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.3, including the javax to jakarta namespace change.
migrations.examples.oracleToPostgres: our on-prem Oracle 12c reporting database (about 40 schemas, 2 TB) to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, including the PL/SQL packages and nightly jobs.
migrations.examples.reactHooks: our React 16 class-component frontend to React 19 with hooks and TypeScript, keeping the existing Redux store working.
migrations.examples.python3: our Python 2.7 data pipelines to Python 3.12 and move from Celery 3 to Celery 5 without changing the task schedule.
migrations.examples.angularJs: our AngularJS 1.x admin portal to Angular 18, one module at a time behind a hybrid router.
migrations.examples.hadoopToDatabricks: our ETL from an on-prem Hadoop and Hive cluster to Databricks on AWS, converting the Hive scripts to Spark SQL.
migrations.examples.cobolToJava: our COBOL batch jobs from the mainframe to Java services, starting with the nightly billing run.
migrations.examples.jenkinsToGitHubActio: our Jenkins pipelines to GitHub Actions across about 60 repositories, keeping the same deploy approval gates.
migrations.examples.expressToNest: our REST APIs from Express 4 in JavaScript to NestJS in TypeScript without breaking existing API clients.
migrations.examples.mongoAtlas: our self-hosted MongoDB 4.4 cluster to MongoDB Atlas 7 and update the drivers in our Node.js services.
migrations.examples.dotnetFramework: our .NET Framework 4.8 web app to .NET 8, including the WCF services and the Entity Framework 6 data layer.
migrations.examples.terraform: our Terraform 0.12 modules to Terraform 1.9 and current provider versions without recreating any resources.
